assertions: all reliability timestamps and revisions are JS-safe integers
updated_at >= created_at
resulting_control_revision >= expected_control_revision
an accepted recovery advances control_revision exactly once and a final recovery replay is frozen
POST recovery and GET recovery polling apply identical confirmed-device observation lifetime, confirmation-window and freshness bounds

rules.trigger: climate_reliability_v1 capability advertised with available=true and producer_guarantees_full_branch=true
assertions: message_code, expected_control_revision, resulting_control_revision, intent and outcomes occur together
accepted, confirmed, message and request_fingerprint are present for every current response
legacy read_back alone is not an enhanced marker
historical 0.63-compatible receipts retain the permissive legacy branch while every capability-negotiated current response uses the full branch
a retained climate_reliability_v1 object with available=false does not activate the full branch

rules.trigger: device outcome counters and execution state
assertions: confirmed command_count > 0 implies accepted_count = command_count and execution_state = applied
confirmed command_count = accepted_count = 0 implies execution_state = already_in_sync and positive room read-back
manual, deferred, pending and undispatched outcomes publish zero command and accepted counts
failed dispatched outcomes never claim an unaccepted command
pending_dispatch is exactly 0/0, accepted_unverified is exactly 1/1, dispatched_not_accepted is exactly 1/0, and mixed recovery is confirmed plus explicit 1/0 failure
all confirmed => confirmed
all manual => manual
all deferred => deferred
all pending => pending
all not_attempted => not_attempted
failed with no confirmed => failed
all other mixtures => partial
only an exactly homogeneous status, reason, execution state and safe message may produce a non-partial room summary
heterogeneous nonconfirmed room outcomes use the neutral partial summary independent of keyed device order
confirmed means all outcomes confirmed
pending has no confirmed or matched outcome
failed or rejected has zero confirmed
partial normally has at least one nonconfirmed outcome and may have zero confirmed; the only empty exception is the canonical omitted-device_ids zero-command recovery no-op
final is false exactly while a pending or accepted_unverified leaf remains; terminal partial has no unfinished leaf
recovery retry is allowed only for final pre_dispatch_failed with zero command and accepted counts
recovery started, unknown, dispatched_not_accepted and accepted_unverified states are non-retryable
a superseded candidate binds a distinct newer operation and request fingerprint
saved_and_applied requires all confirmed
saved_for_manual_device requires manual
saved_deferred_offline requires deferred
saved_apply_failed requires failed
saved_pending_dispatch permits only pending_dispatch 0/0 leaves and pre-dispatch manual, deferred or not_attempted 0/0 exclusions
saved_pending_confirmation requires an after-dispatch non-retryable leaf
saved_blocked_before_dispatch requires not_attempted
superseded_by_newer_intent requires only superseded not_attempted outcomes
room_count, confirmed_room_count and accepted_count equal keyed outcomes
unverifiable recovery count keys are omitted
confirmed control has positive exact room counts
request_id and correlation bind exactly or server correlation fallback is valid
request_fingerprint equals SHA-256 of sorted typed JSON after omitting request_id, correlation_id and request_fingerprint and normalizing scope sets

recovery polls retain a durable request_snapshot with normalized path room, full candidate scope, selected subset, preflight token and fingerprint, confirmation window, reliability profile and supplied or generated correlation policy; its embedded request recomputes request_fingerprint exactly
action, room scope, device identifiers, parameters, expected revisions and POST recovery path bind exactly
temporary set and clear bind requested target_temperature including null; resulting scheduled target is separate
scheduled contour apply binds exact day or night profile through request fingerprint, immutable action snapshot, action receipt and every confirmed leaf
confirmed action read-back and each confirmed device leaf contain exact typed action evidence with null non-applicable axes

every durable operation stores a full typed request projection with request and correlation identifiers, action-specific parameters, expected revisions, resolved scope and a receipt-recomputed fingerprint
every negotiated control receipt stores kind, typed parameters, request fingerprint, resolved scope and expected control revision as one immutable action snapshot
each confirmed control leaf exactly echoes the top action snapshot and nonconfirmed leaves publish no action evidence
every negotiated control receipt freezes a server-authored per-device desired snapshot with a fingerprint, and each confirmed leaf exact-matches that snapshot in fresh observed_actual evidence
resolved scope fingerprints include sorted bounded room-device pairs and must exactly equal keyed outcomes
GET climate, control and recovery operation path operation_id exactly equals the durable receipt operation_id
same request_id and fingerprint replay the original durable operation, while a changed payload conflicts before dispatch and pending or unknown work never redispatches
pending and unknown recovery replay freezes contract, operation, room, revisions, full preflight fingerprint, selected snapshot fingerprint, token and scope

the full recovery preflight contains only explicit manual return_to_contour devices that are managed command-capable climate kinds with enabled, unblocked set_device_mode control and advertised recovery v2 capability; offline eligible devices remain in that full scope only as deferred device_unavailable 0/0, while omitted device_ids freezes only currently available candidates or returns an explicit final zero-command no-op when none is available

each recovery desired snapshot freezes the negotiated v2 preflight source_observed_at; dispatched 1-count leaves publish bounded dispatched_at, and confirmed evidence is strictly newer than both source and dispatch
all four counters equal unique device participation axes
in the negotiated full branch legacy room and device targets equal desired targets while reported targets remain independently observable
device mode and mode_name project participation mode exactly
every negotiated device publishes all six target fields, with null for unsupported, stale or unavailable readings
a negotiated v2 preflight publishes a JS-safe non-null source observed_at for each fresh available selected device; recovery read-back evidence keeps its separate post-dispatch observed_at

recovery request echoes full authoritative preflight fingerprint, sorted command-capable managed candidate scope and opaque token; optional device_ids selects a subset whose receipt snapshot has an independent fingerprint, while omission selects only currently available candidates
automatic available pending devices publish pending_dispatch with its exact safe message, and active operations retain fingerprint, control revision and immutable room-device scope
